title: "R Object Values and Lengths"
output: html_document

## 1) Show the value of each object and use R command to measure the length of them.

```{r}
obj1 <- seq(20,2,-2)
obj2 <- c(2,3,5,7,11)
obj3 <- obj2 >= 5
obj4 <- list("Pizza","Pie","Cake")

obj1
length(obj1)

obj2
length(obj2)

obj3
length(obj3)

obj4
length(obj4)
```
